invariants: Observation never grants or proves authority.
A repository claim coordinates concurrent work and never substitutes for user approval.
PX policy never substitutes for host user approval.
Non-read effects require current user approval, PX policy approval, an idempotency key, and any applicable signed effect grant.
Workspace mutation also requires an active repository claim.
The extension does not spawn Codex or another PX executor.
A PX-owned executor requires explicit delegation and cannot overlap the Codex host on the same operation scope.
